text:
emma: quick Q — PR #4825 updates SOC2 wording for audit export. I need to add a Helm values example showing webhook export retention and a short SDK snippet for customers who set TTL. What language should we use for defaults vs customer-configured values?

sam: For SOC2 we should avoid hard guarantees beyond our controls. Approved phrasing: "Audit logs are retained by default for 90 days; customers can configure retention up to their contractual limits." Add a note that export retention is subject to account settings and legal holds.

jia: thanks. For the SDK example, do we show both JS and Go? I can do tiny snippets. Also: should the Helm example reference a KMS secret or just a placeholder?

maria: Confirming Sam's phrasing is fine. Also add a line about legal holds: "Legal holds override configured retention to preserve data for regulatory or legal reasons." Keep language non-committal on durations beyond the default.

oleg: Helm snippet suggestion — keep it minimal so customers can copy/paste into values.yaml. Example:

```yaml
auditExport:
  enabled: true
  webhook:
    url: https://example.com/endpoint
    retention_days: 90 # default; configurable by customer
    kms_secret: "{{ .Values.secrets.audit_kms_key }}"
```

oleg: For the SDK snippet, show how to set TTL on an export request. JS minimal: 

```js
await client.audit.export({
  target: 'webhook',
  retention_days: 365,
});
```

oleg: And Go: 

```go
client.Audit.Export(ctx, AuditExportOpts{Target: "webhook", RetentionDays: 365})
```

emma: perfect. Two doc asks: 1) can we include a tiny caveat about KV-cache behavior for export metadata? i.e., metadata changes may be delayed in caches for a few minutes — should we call that out? 2) Where should these snippets live — in the audit-export.md page or the retention guide?

sam: call out the KV cache note but keep it short: "Metadata updates may take a few minutes to propagate due to internal caching; retention changes apply to new exports immediately but may not retroactively change already queued payloads." Put the snippets on audit-export.md and cross-link to retention guide.

jia: I can draft both snippets. One more question: do we include CLI/curl example for webhook setup? Might help ops teams.

oleg: yes include a curl example for quick copy: 

```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"target":"webhook","url":"https://example.com/endpoint","retention_days":90}' 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/export
```

docs-bot: PR #4825 opened by @emma — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4825 (status: draft)

emma: I'm going to update the PR with Sam/Maria-approved wording, add the Helm + JS/Go + curl snippets, and the KV cache caveat. Will also add a cross-link to retention guide. Ping @sam @maria for final signoff when done.

sam: thanks — quick review after you push. :thumbsup:

maria: will check legal phrasing after you update.

jia: happy to do a quick tech proofread after the content lands.

oleg: I can add a note in the runtime docs about caching behavior if you want a deeper explanation.

emma: awesome — I'll push in ~30m. Thanks all! :rocket:
